heroCommands.comment: Turn a one-line idea into a repo

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: MetaGPT is a multi-agent framework that simulates a software company. Give it a one-line requirement and AI agents in roles like product manager, architect, project manager and engineer produce user stories, requirements, designs, APIs, documents and code.
sixtySeconds.problem: A single prompt to a language model rarely produces a well-structured project. MetaGPT assigns different roles to separate agents and has them follow standard operating procedures, so the output resembles what a small software team would produce.
whoFor: Builders prototyping apps from short descriptions
Data analysts trying the Data Interpreter agent
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it to explore role-based multi-agent workflows with an established, research-backed framework. It needs Python 3.9 to 3.11 and an LLM API key.
requirements: An LLM API key (OpenAI, Azure, Ollama, Groq and others)

overview: MetaGPT's core idea is Code = SOP(Team): it turns standard operating procedures into prompts for a team of LLM agents. From one requirement it outputs user stories, competitive analysis, requirements, data structures, APIs and documents, and writes the code into a workspace folder.

You can use it from the command line, such as metagpt "Create a 2048 game", or as a Python library with generate_repo. It also includes the Data Interpreter, an agent that writes and runs code for tasks like analysing a dataset and plotting results.

Configuration lives in ~/.metagpt/config2.yaml, where you set the LLM API type, model, base URL and key. The team behind it also publishes research such as AFlow (an ICLR 2025 oral paper) and launched a commercial product, MGX.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from MetaGPT's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Create an environment (optional)
steps.code: conda create -n metagpt python=3.9 && conda activate metagpt

steps.title: Create the config
steps.body: Then edit ~/.metagpt/config2.yaml with your API type, model, base URL and key.

steps.title: Clone and install
steps.code: git clone https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT && cd MetaGPT && pip install --upgrade -e .

tutorial.title: Generate a small game with a team of AI agents
tutorial.useCase: Turn a one-line requirement into a project.

steps.title: Open ./workspace
steps.body: Review the requirements, design documents and code the agents produced.

steps.title: Or call it from Python
steps.code:
from metagpt.software_company import generate_repo
repo = generate_repo("Create a 2048 game")
print(repo)

tutorial.expected: A new project folder in ./workspace with documents and code written by the agent team.
